aiSettings.prompt: Read the first pages of a public meeting agenda from a Michigan city, county or township. Give the meeting's date, start time and location as the agenda states them, and a 2 to 3 sentence summary in plain language of what the meeting will cover. Use null for any field the agenda doesn't state. Never guess.

aiFields.location: City Commission Chambers – 241 West South Street
aiFields.summary: The City Commission will hold a public hearing on the proposed Fiscal Year 2027 budget for the City of Kalamazoo, with no action taken at that time. The consent agenda lists ten items for approval, including engineering and professional service agreements, a water meter purchase, chemical and laboratory contracts, sewer repair work under a Road Commission memorandum, and grant and endowment acceptances with related budget amendments. The regular agenda includes a first reading of an ordinance to change drinking water rates effective January 1, 2027.

aiFields.location: Board of Commissioners Chambers, second floor, County Administration Building, 201 West Kalamazoo Avenue, Kalamazoo, Michigan (also available virtually via YouTube)
aiFields.summary: The Committee of the Whole will review accounts payable and payroll disbursements, a monthly financial report, and the monthly investment report, along with an election update from the County Clerk. It will also hear a StormReady presentation from NOAA, a presentation on an economic mobility and opportunity grant, and discussion of proposed changes to a performance evaluation and step increase policy, a district vacancy, and a first reading of a prematurity awareness proclamation.

aiFields.location: Board of Commissioners Chambers, second floor, County Administration Building, 201 West Kalamazoo Avenue, Kalamazoo, Michigan (also available virtually at kalcounty.gov/board-meetings)
aiFields.summary: The Kalamazoo County Board of Commissioners will honor two employees with 25-year proclamations and review a resignation letter from Chair Jen A. Strebs. The agenda also includes approval of prior minutes, a consent agenda covering appointments, budget adjustments, grant acceptances and contracts across several departments, and proposed amendments to the Board's bylaws. Several non-consent items involve grant agreements and contracts with Southwest Michigan Behavioral Health.
